description: Create a temporary workflow draft for a one-shot plan, scaffolding, or a draft not yet meant for the permanent library. Drafts are retrievable with workflow_get but never appear in workflow_list. A draft stays on disk until it is deleted with workflow_delete — nothing expires it. Writing a name and version that already has a draft overwrites that draft, keeps its created date, and reports status "overwritten"; a name and version held by a permanent workflow is rejected. Created and last-updated dates are stamped automatically.

author.description: Author name or team. Must not be blank or whitespace-only.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does. Must not be blank or whitespace-only.

name.description: Workflow name (human-readable). Must not be blank or whitespace-only.

steps.description: Ordered sequence of steps. Each step must have server and tool fields.

items.description: A single workflow step with server, tool, and optional params/metadata.

params.description: Key-value parameter map. May include {{input.foo}} placeholders, stored verbatim and resolved at execution time.

server.description: Target MCP server name. Must not be blank or whitespace-only.

tool.description: Target tool on the server. Must not be blank or whitespace-only.

version.description: Semver version string (e.g. "1.0.0"). Must be valid semver. Stored in canonical form: surrounding whitespace, a leading "v", and build metadata are dropped, so "v1.0.0+build.5" is stored as "1.0.0".

name: workflow_create_temp

created_date.description: Date the workflow was created (YYYY-MM-DD) — on an overwrite, the replaced draft’s original date.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_input`: A field passed schema validation but is semantically invalid: a whitespace-only name, description, author, or step server/tool, or a name that exceeds the filename length limit after slugification. `already_exists`: A permanent workflow already holds this name@version, and a temporary draft cannot share its key. `write_failed`: Filesystem write error such as insufficient permissions or a full disk. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

filePath.description: Absolute path where the workflow was written.

key.description: Index key for this workflow: name@version, with the version in canonical form.

last_updated_date.description: Date the workflow was last updated (YYYY-MM-DD).

notice.description: Reminder that the workflow is a temporary draft: excluded from workflow_list, retrievable with workflow_get, kept until deleted with workflow_delete.

status.description: Outcome of the write: "created" for a new draft, "overwritten" when it replaced the existing draft with the same name and version. Either way the draft is on disk and indexed.

title: Create Temporary Workflow
